message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is my last work session. It is now 6:30 PM on Friday, and Brad has not responded to my message from earlier this afternoon. Without his input on the availability of Elena Soto and David Okafor, I cannot proceed with booking the meeting. I have already provided him with all the possible times that work for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. At this point, I have exhausted all possible actions I can take.

I will leave a final message in the workspace for Brad, letting him know that this was my last session and that he will need to take over the task from here. I will ask him to book one of the times I provided if it works for his partners and to send the confirmation email. This is the only way to ensure the task has a chance of being completed. After leaving this message, I will end my session.

It's the end of the day, and I'm wrapping up this session. I've hit a stopping point, having exhausted my efforts. I sent Brad the calendar slots, and now it's out of my hands. I'm waiting for a response and prepared to pick it up later if needed.


**Ending the Process**

It's Friday evening, 6:30 PM, and I've reached the session's end. I still haven't heard back from Brad, so I can't move forward. I've done everything on my end: checked the calendars, found the slots, and shared them. I will send a final update to the workspace to inform Brad of the situation and then conclude this session.
